note: Built-in calisthenics library (decision 0062). Progressions run easiest first within each family. Guidance is general coaching practice, not medical advice: stop on sharp or joint pain.

exercises.name: Wall push-up
exercises.description: A push-up against a wall: the first step of the push-up progression.
instructions: Stand an arm's length from a wall, hands at shoulder height and width.
Lower your chest to the wall with your body in one straight line.
Press back to straight arms.
form: Keep heels, hips and shoulders in one line.
Elbows about 45 degrees from the body, not flared.
safety: Stand on a non-slip floor.

exercises.name: Incline push-up
exercises.description: Hands on a bench, box or bar: harder the lower the support.
instructions: Hands on a stable surface at hip height or lower.
Lower until your chest nearly touches it.
Press up, keeping a straight line.
form: Brace your stomach; don't let the hips sag.
Touch the same point on the support each rep.
safety: Make sure the support can't slide or tip.

exercises.name: Knee push-up
exercises.description: A floor push-up from the knees.
instructions: Knees on the floor, hands under the shoulders.
Lower your chest to a fist's height from the floor.
Press up.
form: Line from knees to head stays straight.
safety: Pad the knees if the floor is hard.

exercises.name: Push-up
exercises.description: The full floor push-up.
instructions: Hands under the shoulders, body straight from heels to head.
Lower until your chest is a fist from the floor.
Press to straight arms without letting the hips lead.
form: Squeeze glutes and brace.
Full range: chest down, arms straight at the top.
safety: Drop back to knee push-ups when form breaks.

exercises.name: Diamond push-up
exercises.description: Hands close together under the chest: more triceps.
instructions: Index fingers and thumbs touching under the chest.
Lower with elbows close to the ribs.
Press up.
form: Elbows travel back, not out.
safety: Widen the hands slightly if the wrists or elbows complain.

exercises.name: Archer push-up
exercises.description: Wide hands, shifting the weight to one arm while the other stays straight: a step toward one-arm push-ups.
instructions: Hands wide, fingers out.
Lower toward one hand while the other arm straightens.
Press back and alternate sides.
form: Keep the hips square to the floor.
safety: Build to 3 × 15 full push-ups first.

exercises.name: Pseudo planche push-up
exercises.description: Hands turned out by the hips with the shoulders leaning past them: heavy front-shoulder load.
instructions: Hands by the lower ribs, fingers turned out.
Lean forward so the shoulders are ahead of the hands.
Lower and press while keeping the lean.
form: Keep the lean through every rep.
Protract (push the floor away) at the top.
safety: Warm up the wrists; reduce the lean if they hurt.

exercises.name: Dead hang
exercises.description: Hanging from a bar: grip strength and shoulder tolerance for pulling.
instructions: Grip the bar shoulder width, palms forward.
Hang with straight arms and feet off the floor.
Breathe and hold.
form: Keep a light brace, ribs down.
safety: Step down; don't drop from height.
Stop if the shoulder pinches.

exercises.name: Scapular pull-up
exercises.description: From a dead hang, pull the shoulder blades down without bending the elbows.
instructions: Start in a dead hang.
Pull the shoulders down and back so the body rises a little.
Lower slowly.
form: Arms stay straight the whole time.
safety: Move slowly; no swinging.

exercises.name: Australian row
exercises.description: A bodyweight row under a low bar or rings.
instructions: Hang under a waist-height bar, body straight, heels on the floor.
Pull your chest to the bar.
Lower with control.
form: Squeeze the shoulder blades at the top.
Body stays in one line.
safety: Check the bar or ring straps are secure.

exercises.name: Negative pull-up
exercises.description: Jump or step to the top of a pull-up and lower slowly.
instructions: Start with the chin over the bar (jump or use a box).
Lower over 3 to 5 seconds to straight arms.
Reset and repeat.
form: Control the whole way down; don't drop the last part.
safety: Use a stable box to reach the top.

exercises.name: Pull-up
exercises.description: The full pull-up, palms facing away.
instructions: Dead hang, hands just wider than the shoulders.
Pull until the chin clears the bar.
Lower to straight arms.
form: Start each rep from straight arms.
No kipping or swinging.
safety: Load in kg only once 3 × 10 clean reps are easy.

exercises.name: Chin-up
exercises.description: A pull-up with palms facing you: more biceps.
instructions: Shoulder-width underhand grip.
Pull until the chin clears the bar.
Lower to straight arms.
form: Full range, no swinging.
safety: Ease off if the inner elbow aches.

exercises.name: Archer pull-up
exercises.description: A wide pull-up toward one hand while the other arm straightens: toward the one-arm pull-up.
instructions: Wide grip.
Pull toward one hand, the other arm sliding straight along the bar.
Lower and alternate.
form: Keep the working shoulder down, away from the ear.
safety: Build to 3 × 10 pull-ups first.

exercises.name: Bench dip
exercises.description: Dips with hands on a bench behind you and feet on the floor.
instructions: Hands on the bench edge, fingers forward.
Lower until the elbows reach about 90 degrees.
Press up.
form: Keep the back close to the bench.
safety: Stop short of depth that pinches the front of the shoulder.

exercises.name: Support hold
exercises.description: Holding yourself up on straight arms on dip bars, parallettes or rings.
instructions: Press up to straight arms.
Shoulders down, body still.
Hold.
form: Push the bars away; don't sink into the shoulders.
safety: Step down under control.

exercises.name: Dip
exercises.description: The full parallel-bar dip.
instructions: Start in a support hold.
Lower until the shoulders are just below the elbows.
Press back to straight arms.
form: Slight forward lean, elbows back.
safety: Don't bounce at the bottom.
Load in kg only once 3 × 12 is easy.

exercises.name: Ring dip
exercises.description: Dips on rings: the rings move, so stability is the challenge.
instructions: Support hold on rings, rings turned out slightly.
Lower with the rings close to the body.
Press up and turn the rings out at the top.
form: Keep the rings close to the ribs.
safety: Master 3 × 10 bar dips first.

exercises.name: Bodyweight squat
exercises.description: The basic squat.
instructions: Feet shoulder width, toes slightly out.
Sit down between the heels as deep as you can with a neutral back.
Stand up.
form: Knees track over the toes.
Heels stay down.
safety: Reduce depth if the knees hurt.

exercises.name: Split squat
exercises.description: A static lunge, one leg at a time.
instructions: Long stance, one foot forward.
Lower the back knee toward the floor.
Stand up; finish one side, then the other.
form: Torso tall, front knee over the foot.
safety: Hold a wall for balance at first.

exercises.name: Bulgarian split squat
exercises.description: A split squat with the back foot raised.
instructions: Back foot on a bench behind you.
Lower until the front thigh is about level.
Stand up; both sides.
form: Most of the weight on the front foot.
safety: Use a stable bench.

exercises.name: Assisted pistol squat
exercises.description: A one-leg squat holding a post, door frame or rings.
instructions: Stand on one leg, other leg forward.
Squat as deep as you can, holding the support lightly.
Stand up; both sides.
form: Use the support only as much as you need.
safety: Stop if the knee hurts.

exercises.name: Pistol squat
exercises.description: The full one-leg squat.
instructions: Stand on one leg, other leg straight forward.
Squat to the bottom with the heel down.
Stand up; both sides.
form: Arms forward for balance.
Control the bottom; no bounce.
safety: Use assisted pistols until the bottom is controlled.

exercises.name: Glute bridge
exercises.description: Lying on your back, lift the hips.
instructions: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat.
Press through the heels to lift the hips.
Lower slowly.
form: Squeeze the glutes at the top; ribs down.
safety: Don't over-arch the lower back.

exercises.name: Calf raise
exercises.description: Rise onto the toes and lower, on a step for more range.
instructions: Stand on the edge of a step.
Rise as high as you can.
Lower below level slowly.
form: Pause at the top.
safety: Hold a rail for balance.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.description: Holding a straight line on the forearms.
instructions: Forearms under the shoulders, legs straight.
Brace so the body is one line.
Hold and breathe.
form: Squeeze glutes; don't let the hips sag or pike.
safety: End the set when form breaks.

exercises.name: Side plank
exercises.description: A plank on one forearm, facing sideways.
instructions: Elbow under the shoulder, feet stacked.
Lift the hips into a straight line.
Hold; both sides.
form: Hips high, body in one plane.
safety: Knees down to make it easier.

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.description: On your back, extend the opposite arm and leg while the lower back stays down.
instructions: Back flat, arms up, knees over the hips.
Lower one arm and the opposite leg toward the floor.
Return and alternate.
form: Lower back stays pressed into the floor.
safety: Shorten the range if the back lifts.

exercises.name: Hollow body hold
exercises.description: The core position behind most calisthenics skills.
instructions: Lie on your back, lower back pressed down.
Lift the shoulders and straight legs a little off the floor.
Hold.
form: Lower back never lifts; bend the knees to make it easier.
safety: Stop if the lower back arches.

exercises.name: Hanging knee raise
exercises.description: From a dead hang, bring the knees to the chest.
instructions: Dead hang.
Curl the knees up toward the chest.
Lower slowly without swinging.
form: Tilt the pelvis up at the top.
safety: Control the swing.

exercises.name: Tuck L-sit
exercises.description: A support hold with the knees tucked to the chest and the feet off the floor.
instructions: Hands on parallettes or the floor beside the hips.
Press down and lift the hips and feet.
Hold with the knees tucked.
form: Shoulders pushed down, arms locked.
safety: Warm up the wrists.

exercises.name: L-sit
exercises.description: The support hold with straight legs out in front at hip height.
instructions: From a tuck L-sit, extend the legs straight.
Hold the legs level.
Breathe and hold.
form: Knees locked, toes pointed.
safety: Build to 3 × 15 s tuck L-sits first.

exercises.name: Wall handstand hold
exercises.description: A handstand with the chest facing the wall: shoulder strength and line.
instructions: Walk the feet up the wall until the body is near vertical, chest to the wall.
Push tall through the shoulders.
Hold, then walk down.
form: Arms by the ears, ribs in.
safety: Clear space around you.
Walk down under control; don't fall sideways.

exercises.name: Crow pose
exercises.description: Balancing on the hands with the knees resting on the backs of the upper arms.
instructions: Squat with the hands on the floor.
Rest the knees on the upper arms and lean forward.
Lift the feet and hold.
form: Look slightly forward, not down.
safety: Put a cushion in front of your face.
